selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed no pre-existing appworker user, then created it with useradd -m and verified uid/gid via id

selected_evidence.requirement: Login sessions limited to 8,192 open files and 256 processes
selected_evidence.summary: Wrote limits.d drop-in with nofile/nproc 8192/256, confirmed pam_limits active, and verified real login session (su -) reports ulimit -n=8192 and ulimit -u=256
Captured pre-restart boot_id (7223d5b7...) and systemctl is-system-running=running
systemctl reboot issued in background (ack returned), subsequent polls show connection timeouts/resets confirming the node actually went down

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 boot identity changed after restart
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id is f377f98c..., differing from the pre-restart 7223d5b7..., proving an actual reboot occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery of appworker account and limits
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, appworker id resolves correctly, limits.d config file persisted, su - login session still shows ulimit -n=8192/ulimit -u=256, and system is fully running

commands.command: cat /etc/os-release | head -5; id appworker 2>&1; sudo -n true 2>&1 && echo SUDO_OK

commands.command:
printf '%s\n' \
'appworker soft nofile 8192' \
'appworker hard nofile 8192' \
'appworker soft nproc 256' \
'appworker hard nproc 256' \
| sudo tee /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf
cat /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf
commands.stdout:
appworker soft nofile 8192
appworker hard nofile 8192
appworker soft nproc 256
appworker hard nproc 256
appworker soft nofile 8192
appworker hard nofile 8192
appworker soft nproc 256
appworker hard nproc 256

commands.command:
grep -r pam_limits /etc/pam.d/system-auth /etc/pam.d/login /etc/pam.d/su 2>&1
sudo su - appworker -c 'ulimit -n; ulimit -u'
nohup sudo systemctl reboot >/tmp/reboot.log 2>&1 & echo "reboot issued: $!"

id appworker
cat /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf
sudo su - appworker -c 'ulimit -n; ulimit -u'
systemctl is-system-running
